name: Asia-Pacific Economic and Business History Conference 2027
organizer: Economic History Society of Australia and New Zealand (EHSANZ); ANU Centre for Economic History
conf_dates_note: Theme: "Innovation - Historical Perspectives from Asia-Pacific and the World"
submission_requirements: Abstract or full paper by email; session proposals of one page outlining objectives and potential participants
registration_fee: Early (before 12 Jan 2027): AUD 150 EHSANZ members / AUD 250 non-members; late (from 12 Jan 2027): AUD 200 members / AUD 300 non-members; conference dinner AUD 120; graduate students free with proof of enrolment and paper acceptance
keynotes: David S. Jacks (Noel Butlin lecture); Andrew Leigh MP (plenary)
